title: HtmlInputSubmit
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type submit without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputSubmit.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet prop accepted by the component and removed before the remaining attributes are spread onto the element. It has no rendered effect because the component renders a native void input.

outputs.name: HtmlInputSubmit
outputs.description: The rendered native input element with all remaining supplied attributes spread onto it. It has no wrapper or child content, and its explicit type is always submit.
